g.text: How a folder route finds what to send

text.tspan: A part starts with a dot,
or it leads out of the folder?
The path is the part below the route path, decoded. Other methods get 405.
A dot part covers .git, .env and .. (also %2e%2e). Symlinks are followed first,
so a link out of the folder is a 404, the same as a missing file.
